issue_request: FHIR-7031 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked whether translation codings in a CodeableConcept input to ConceptMap translation are allowed and whether they are evaluated, especially in batch translation use.
initial_application: The original application was git commit e5a7c238c6, corresponding to svn revision 5699, which added '(e.g. existing translations)' to the ConceptMap translate CodeableConcept input documentation. That wording was preserved through the migration from spreadsheet source to the current OperationDefinition XML.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and its operation list references OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. Later FHIR-32129 and FHIR-41175 source/target input renames and example harmonization are already represented on the combined branch and did not remove the FHIR-7031 clarification. A 2018 Zulip discussion quoted the same wording and advised separate batched requests when an implementation needs per-source association.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active OperationDefinition documents sourceCodeableConcept and targetCodeableConcept as CodeableConcept inputs whose coding values, including existing translations, may be translated by the server.
